questions.question: Who came to test Solomon with hard questions?
How did the queen of Sheba react to Solomon's wisdom and wealth?
options: She was wholly unimpressed by it
There was no more breath in her
She left the city at once in anger
questions.answer: There was no more breath in her

questions.question: Solomon surpassed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
